# ISO/DIS 9002

Quality management systems — Guidance for the application of ISO 9001

French title: Titre manque

Status: Under development, stage 40.60 Close of voting.
Type: International Standard.
Edition 3, 78 pages.
Languages: en, fr.
Committee: ISO/TC 176/SC 2, Quality systems.
ICS: 03.120.10 Quality management and quality assurance; 03.100.70 Management systems.
Replaces: ISO/TS 9002:2016 (current).

## Abstract

This document provides guidance on the intent of the requirements in ISO 9001, with examples of possible steps an organization can take to meet the requirements. It does not add to, subtract from, or in any way modify those requirements.

This dcument does not prescribe mandatory approaches to implementation, or provide any preferred method of interpretation.

ISO's page of it: https://www.iso.org/standard/91841.html
